name: Mansion (working name)
status: draft 2: four floors, locks and puzzles. Ground floor traced from the source plan; basement, upper floor and attic designed by Claude on the same footprint. Not yet checked by James or built by Astra.

axes.x: to the right on the source drawing
axes.y: down the source drawing, from the garden front (top) to the entrance front (bottom)
axes.godot: x -> X, y -> Z, floor_y + height -> Y (up). Origin = outer top-left corner of the main block.

trace.note: Scale set from the main block's outer width (1107 px = 51.2 m). The hand-written room sizes on the drawing are in feet and disagree with each other by up to about 10%; the trace wins.

triggers.name: High-score code
triggers.how: One cabinet's attract screen shows the top-five score table. The initials beside the scores spell a four-glyph code. Enter it on the keypad at the foot of the east stair.

triggers.name: Button behind the screen
triggers.how: A recessed button under the bottom-right corner of the projector screen frame. Only visible in the flashlight beam.

triggers.name: Empty rack slot
triggers.how: One bottle slot in the left rack holds a button instead of a bottle.

triggers.name: Camera grid
triggers.how: Cycle the eight monitors until all of them show the same room. The room they agree on is the Battery Room, and the wall there opens.

triggers.name: Access key
triggers.how: A key card in the panic room's locker.

triggers.name: Wireframe maze
triggers.how: Sit in a sim pod and walk a wireframe maze. Reaching its centre releases the attic hatch.

triggers.name: Star chart
triggers.how: Turn the telescope to the three marks drawn on the chart. When all three line up, the radio room door unlocks.

triggers.name: Telescope base
triggers.how: A button on the back of the telescope's base.

triggers.name: Tune the frequency
triggers.how: Turn the big dial until the static clears. The right setting is written in the Hidden Archive and on the Forgotten Bedroom's wall.
